task_title: Wire user-defined rules into the Decider (TJ-DF-004)
task_criteria: RuleLoader.load_all() is wired into Decider: user rules load from config system/user rules.d dirs and evaluate after builtins; decider.py Layer 4 is no longer a comment stub
Same-ID override works: a user rule whose id matches a builtin replaces it (T-I38) - user allow rule id=builtin-rm-rf-root makes 'rm -rf /' return allow while other builtins (curl|sh) stay blocked

New-id user block rule fires: a 99-dogfood.yaml rule blocking 'git push --force' makes intercept() return action=block with rule_id=user-block-force-push; bridge subprocess with TERMINAL_JAIL_INTERRUPTOR_USER_RULES_DIR env returns the same block (CLI-path equivalent)
Priority ordering (T-I39): higher-priority user rule wins when multiple user rules match the same command
No false positives: benign commands (git status, echo hello, ls -la) stay allow with user rules loaded; builtin precedence holds (curl|sh and rm -rf / still blocked)
Missing rules directory acts as pass-through (spec section 14): no exception, builtins still active
Full suite green: pytest 270 passed / 4 skipped (was 256/6, two Layer-4 skip stubs converted to real tests), ruff check plugin/ standalone/ clean, gitreins guard 4/4 PASS

Commit c425379 addresses TJ-DF-004, changes only plugin/terminal_jail/interruptor/decider.py + plugin/test_interruptor.py + plugin/test_interruptor_integration.py, and includes the Co-authored-by trailer; no push, no board edits
